title: UnrealBloomPass Neon Scene Post-Processing
prompt:
Use Three.js to add glow (Bloom) to 20 randomly distributed neon-colored spheres in a dark scene through a post-processing pipeline.

[Three.js Import Method (Must Be Followed Strictly)]
Use the following importmap in <head>, and import via ES Modules in <script type="module">:
<script type="importmap">
{ "imports": {
    "three": "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.170.0/build/three.module.js",
    "three/addons/": "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.170.0/examples/jsm/"
} }
</script>
<script type="module">
import * as THREE from 'three';
import { OrbitControls } from 'three/addons/controls/OrbitControls.js';
import { EffectComposer } from 'three/addons/postprocessing/EffectComposer.js';
import { RenderPass } from 'three/addons/postprocessing/RenderPass.js';
import { UnrealBloomPass } from 'three/addons/postprocessing/UnrealBloomPass.js';
import { ShaderPass } from 'three/addons/postprocessing/ShaderPass.js';
import { FXAAShader } from 'three/addons/shaders/FXAAShader.js';
</script>

[Scene]
(1) Use a dark background (such as #000208). The scene must contain exactly 20 spheres using MeshStandardMaterial or MeshBasicMaterial, with random highly saturated colors and slight self-illumination or high emissive intensity so that the Bloom effect is clearly visible.
(2) EffectComposer: RenderPass + UnrealBloomPass; optionally, an FXAA ShaderPass.

[Controls]
(3) An id="bloomStrength" slider ranging from 0–3, bound to UnrealBloomPass.strength.
(4) An id="bloomRadius" slider ranging from 0–1, bound to radius.
(5) An id="bloomThreshold" slider ranging from 0–1, bound to threshold.
(6) id="bloomToggle": toggle Bloom on or off. When disabled, UnrealBloomPass may be bypassed for direct rendering, or strength may be set to 0; the state must be reflected in __3D_STATE__.bloomEnabled.
(7) id="fxaaToggle": toggle FXAA on or off.

[State Exposure (Required)]
Update window.__3D_STATE__ every frame:
  - bloomStrength, bloomRadius, bloomThreshold: number
  - bloomEnabled, fxaaEnabled: boolean
  - objectCount: number (should be 20)
  - fps: number (moving average or instantaneous frame rate)

Output a single HTML file.
